title: 自販機横のびん・缶回収箱
description: 自動販売機の横に置く、空きびん・缶の回収箱です。白い樹脂の本体、二つの丸い投入口を持つ傾斜した青いふた、前面の点検扉と錠・蝶番、無地のラベル帯、アジャスター脚を造形しています。分別表示の文字や図記号、中の容器、扉の開閉動作は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.480 × 0.977 × 0.416 m、2,824三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A recycling bin for empty bottles and cans, placed beside vending machines. It models the white polyethylene body, a sloped blue lid with two round deposit openings, the front service door with lock and hinges, a blank label band and leveling feet. Sorting text and symbols, contained bottles and door motion are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.480 × 0.977 × 0.416 m; 2,824 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
